Row.Text: A shadowed profile of a bald man with glasses, set against a bright yellow background with faint dark lines.

The central image displays a dark silhouette of a bald man's head, shown in profile and facing left. He wears round glasses and has a mustache or goatee, with a small patch of white hair at the back of his head. The left side of his face is strongly illuminated by a bright yellow-orange light, highlighting his features against the deep blue and black shadow of his form. The image is contained within a rectangular frame with a light gray, ornate, aged-stone border. A vibrant yellow-orange light fills the background, overlaid with subtle, dark, abstract lines resembling intricate mechanical components or a diagram.
A dark silhouette of a person's profile, outlined in purple light, within a textured gray frame.

The central image is a dark silhouette of a person's head and shoulders, depicted in profile facing left. The figure is completely black, with the back of their short, curly hair and the outline of their form illuminated by a vibrant purple light. This silhouette is set against a gradient dark purple background, which is slightly lighter directly around the figure. Faint, dark shapes resembling small birds are visible flying downwards on the left side of the background. The entire picture is enclosed within a thick, textured, light gray frame with rounded corners, resembling weathered stone.
A dark silhouetted head with long hair is split by purple light on the left and red light on the right, within a stone frame.

The emblem features a shadowy human-like head with long hair, depicted in profile or partial view. The figure's left side is highlighted by a cool bluish-purple light, revealing the contours of the face and a reddish glow near the nose. The right side and flowing hair are brightly illuminated by a vivid red light. A decorative, light grey stone frame with intricate carvings encloses the image. Inside this frame, the central figure is set against a dark red background that subtly depicts flying bat shapes on the right.
A deeply shadowed, hooded figure with parts of the hood glowing greenish-yellow and blue, framed by a grey border.

The central image features a shadowy, hooded figure seen in profile, looking towards the right. The face is almost entirely obscured by deep shadow, with only faint hints of a nose, mouth, and chin visible. The hood is dramatically lit from opposing sides: the left side glows a bright greenish-yellow, and the right side is illuminated in a vibrant blue. These two colors meet and fade into the deep shadows covering the figure's face and the interior of the hood. The entire image is contained within a rectangular light grey frame that resembles textured stone or metal, with slightly rounded corners. The background directly behind the figure is a dark, mottled green. The composition emphasizes the obscured nature of the figure.
